newsitem.title: USA: Ticketmaster in Central and South America deal.
newsitem.headline: Ticketmaster in Central and South America deal.

text.p: Ticketmaster Group Inc said Thursday it agreed to jointly develop automated ticketing in Central and South America with CIE International SA de CV.
CIE is an affiliate of its 27 percent-owned Mexican licensee, Venta de Boletos por Computadora SA de CV.
Ticketmaster will manage and control the venture with a 51 percent majority interest.
The company said the venture will initially focus on developing the Argentine and Brazilian markets, and it expects the first operation to be launched this fall.

Under the terms of the agreement, Ticketmaster will also receive an additional 22.9 percent ownership stake in Venta de Boletos por Computadora SA de CV upon the beginning of the first business operation, giving Ticketmaster a 49.9 percent interest in its Mexican licensee.
